disabled.description: The fill a dead control wears.

on-disabled.description: The ink on a dead control's fill.

family.description: The face a level-one heading reads in. The display face, unless the theme says otherwise.

size.description: The size a level-one heading reads at. The top of the ladder, unless the theme says otherwise.

weight.description: The weight a level-one heading reads at. The ladder's bold, unless the theme says otherwise.

family.description: The face a level-two heading reads in.

size.description: The size a level-two heading reads at.

weight.description: The weight a level-two heading reads at.

family.description: The face a level-three heading reads in.

size.description: The size a level-three heading reads at.

weight.description: The weight a level-three heading reads at.

family.description: The face a level-four heading reads in.

size.description: The size a level-four heading reads at.

weight.description: The weight a level-four heading reads at.

family.description: The face a level-five heading reads in.

size.description: The size a level-five heading reads at.

weight.description: The weight a level-five heading reads at.

family.description: The face a level-six heading reads in.

size.description: The size a level-six heading reads at.

weight.description: The weight a level-six heading reads at.

family.description: The face a paragraph reads in. The body face, unless the theme says otherwise.

size.description: The size a paragraph reads at. The body's size, unless the theme says otherwise.

weight.description: The weight a paragraph reads at.

family.description: The face a quotation reads in. The editorial face, unless the theme says otherwise.

size.description: The size a quotation reads at.

weight.description: The weight a quotation reads at.

family.description: The face a run of code reads in. The mono face, unless the theme says otherwise.

size.description: The size a run of code reads at.

weight.description: The weight a run of code reads at.

family.description: The face a small label reads in.

size.description: The size a small label reads at.

weight.description: The weight a small label reads at.

family.description: The face a strong run reads in.

size.description: The size a strong run reads at. The size of the text it sits in.

weight.description: The weight a strong run reads at. The ladder's bold, unless the theme says otherwise.

family.description: The face a link reads in.

size.description: The size a link reads at. The size of the text it sits in.

weight.description: The weight a link reads at.

family.description: The face a caption reads in.

size.description: The size a caption reads at.

weight.description: The weight a caption reads at.

sm.description: The size for a face in a list or a comment.

md.description: The default: a face beside a name, or a profile header at rest.

lg.description: A face as the subject of a page.

edge.description: The stroke the badge draws around itself.

pill.description: Whether the badge is a pill or a square tag.

weight.description: The button's own weight: a control carries more than the prose around it.

case.description: The case a button's label is written in.

tracking.description: The tracking of a button's label.

shadow.description: The elevation a button rests at.

shadow-hover.description: The elevation a button lifts to when it is touched.

depth.description: How physical a checkbox is: one scalar driving three inset shadows.
How physical a switch is: one scalar driving three inset shadows.

sm.description: The smallest glyph step, in `em` so it tracks the control it sits in.

radius.description: The card's own corner. A card is not a button and need not round the same way.

padding.description: The air inside the card, between its parts and around its edge.

border.description: The ink of the card's own edge, when it draws one.

elevation.description: The elevation the card rests at. A card that sits on the page says so.

padding.description: The air above and below the alert's text.

padding-inline.description: The air beside the alert's text, where the message is read.

edge.description: The ink of the hairline the alert wears on every side.

border.description: The ink of the field's own edge: the line a finger has to find.

value-size.description: The size of the number a stat shows.

value-weight.description: The weight of the number a stat shows.

value-family.description: The face the number a stat shows is set in: a figure is a figure, and the mono is the face that carries figures.

header-weight.description: The weight of a column's heading.

rule.description: The ink of the rule under a row.

zebra.description: The fill a striped row wears.

underline.description: The thickness of the rule under a link. Zero marks the link by colour alone.

modes.description: The modes this theme serves. A mode the theme serves but does not override falls back to the base values.
